The scores from the pathways indicate a moderate level of support for this relationship, with varying confidence levels across the different paths. The evidence suggests that Trabectedin may have a role in the treatment of this condition, though further research is needed to confirm its therapeutic potential. The mechanisms underlying this relationship are not fully elucidated, and the strength of the evidence remains moderate.
